Sound colleagues at the Grafisch Lyceum Rotterdam
Sharing experiences with Tartu Vocational College

Thanks to the Erasmus+ KA1 project offered by Tartanga, two teachers from our school have had the opportunity to visit Fatih Sultan Mehmet Vakif University in Turkey. It has been an incredible experience, as in addition to being a different country, they are also seeing how different cultures influence teaching. We hope to continue working together in the future.
